items.title: Employment ends (termination effective date)
items.quote: Wir kündigen deshalb das Arbeitsverhältnis ordentlich unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Frist zum 31.01.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the statutory notice period ends and the employment relationship terminates 'zum 31.01.2027' - an explicit calendar date given in the letter, so no further calculation is needed.

items.title: Register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit
items.quote: Um Nachteile beim Arbeitslosengeld zu vermeiden, müssen Sie sich sofort bei der Agentur für Arbeit arbeitsuchend melden.
items.computation: Under § 38 Abs. 1 SGB III, if the time between gaining knowledge of the termination date and the actual end of the employment is less than three months, the employee must register as job-seeking within three days of gaining that knowledge. Knowledge/receipt occurred on the personal handover date 18.11.2026 (Wednesday). The gap to the end date 31.01.2027 is about 2 months 13 days, i.e. under 3 months, so the 3-day rule applies. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (18.11.2026) is not counted; the period starts 19.11.2026 (Thu). Three calendar days run 19.11 (Thu), 20.11 (Fri), 21.11 (Sat) - the last day. Since 21.11.2026 is a Saturday, under § 193 BGB (applied analogously in social law) the deadline is extended to the next business day, Monday 23.11.2026.

items.title: File Kündigungsschutzklage with the Arbeitsgericht (if contesting the termination)
items.quote: Zu Ihrer Information: Eine Klage gegen diese Kündigung wäre innerhalb von drei Wochen nach Erhalt des Schreibens beim Arbeitsgericht einzureichen.
items.computation: Under § 4 KSchG, a Kündigungsschutzklage must reach the Arbeitsgericht within three weeks of receipt ('Zugang') of the written termination. The letter was personally handed over (witnessed) on 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), so Zugang = 18.11.2026. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Zugang is excluded; the period runs under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB and ends on the day in the third following week bearing the same name as the day of Zugang, i.e. the Wednesday three weeks later: 18.11.2026 + 21 days = 09.12.2026 (Wednesday), which is not a weekend or public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz, so no extension under § 193 BGB is needed.

warnings: The statutory deadline to register as job-seeking with the Agentur für Arbeit (23.11.2026, computed from the 3-day rule in § 38 SGB III) has already passed relative to today's date (24.11.2026); if this was not yet done, it should be attended to immediately as it may affect unemployment benefit entitlements.

The letter's note about the three-week lawsuit deadline is explicitly framed as 'Zur Information' and not a formal Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung; the computed date (09.12.2026) should still be treated as the binding statutory deadline under § 4 KSchG if the termination is to be contested.
